title: Set Required Validator on Form Field
synonyms: add required validation to form field
explanation: Sets a required validator on the 'departmentName' field of the 'departmentForm' when the page is ready.

title: Set Required Validator on Table Column
synonyms: add required validation to table column
code:
var VALIDATOR = App.getDependency('CONSTANTS').VALIDATOR;
 Page.Widgets.environmentsTable.columns.isActive.setValidators([{ type: VALIDATOR.REQUIRED, validator: true, errorMessage: 'This field cannot be empty.' }]);
explanation: Sets a required validator on the 'isActive' column in the 'environmentsTable'.

title: Custom Validator on Form Field
explanation: Applies a custom validator on the 'username' field of 'loginForm' to ensure at least 2 characters on opening the dialog.

title: Custom Validator on Table Column
explanation: Applies a custom validator on 'isBoarded' column of 'onBoardTable' to check minimum length.

title: Combined Validators on Form Field
explanation: Combines a required custom check and regex email format validation for 'lastname' field in 'employeeForm'.

title: Combined Validators on Table Column
synonyms: add multiple validations to table column
explanation: Combines required and regex validation on 'lastname' column of 'userTable'.

title: Observe and Confirm Password Validation - Form
explanation: Ensures confirm password matches password in 'EmployeeForm1'.

title: Observe and Confirm Password Validation - Table
explanation: Validates matching password-confirm password in the specified table.

title: Set Async Validator on Email Field
explanation: Adds asynchronous validator to check if email already exists in 'RegistationForm'.

title: Before Submit on Form
explanation: Validates username length before form submission and sets creation timestamp if valid.

title: Submit Form and Invoke Service Variable
explanation: Submits the form and passes form data as input to 'createUser' service variable.

title: Handle Success after Form Submit
explanation: Handles post-submit success by updating app variable and label with submitted user name.

title: Handle Error on Form Submit
explanation: Logs error response to console when form submission fails.

title: Data Table Row Click Handler
explanation: On clicking a row, sets selected department info, updates labels, and navigates to department details page.

title: Data Table Row Select Event
explanation: Logs index and content of selected row when row selection occurs.

title: Data Table Row Deselect Event
explanation: Logs details of the row when deselected in the Data Table.

title: Data Table Sort Event
explanation: Logs sorting details when a table column is sorted.

title: Data Table Header Click Event
explanation: Logs which column header was clicked in a Data Table.

title: List Click and Fetch Details
explanation: Triggered on list item click; fetches department details and updates label with selected name.

title: List  Double Click to Navigate
explanation: Navigates to department details page using data from the double-clicked list item.

title: List  Mouse Enter Highlight
explanation: Adds CSS highlight and updates label inside hovered list item. //here widget.item is the list item data and widget._currentItemWidgets gives the widgets which are present in li or list item

title: List  Mouse Leave Reset
explanation: Removes hover style and resets label text on list item mouse leave. //here widget.itemClass is the class is for  list and widget._currentItemWidgets gives the widgets which are present in li or list item

title: List Enter Key Press Trigger
explanation: Fires search with keyword from selected item when Enter is pressed.

title: List Pagination Change
explanation: Loads new page of data when pagination changes in list widget.

title: Select Specific Item in List
code: Page.Widgets.EmployeeList1.selectItem(1);
explanation: Programmatically selects the item at index 1 in the list.

title: Deselect Item in List
code: Page.Widgets.EmployeeList1.deselectItem(1);
explanation: Removes selection from the item at index 1 in the list widget.

title: Clear All Items from List
code: Page.Widgets.EmployeeList1.clear();
explanation: Clears all data/items from the list widget.

title: Card Click to Open Dialog and Set Variable
explanation: Opens a dialog and sets selected user into a variable when the card is clicked.

title: Card Double Click to Navigate
explanation: Navigates to the user detail page with ID and name from the selected card item.

title: Card Mouse Enter Styling and Label Update
explanation: Adds CSS class and updates a label inside card on mouse hover. // widget._currentItemWidgets gives the widgets which are present in li or list item

title: Card Mouse Leave Styling Reset
explanation: Removes hover class and restores original email value when mouse leaves the card. //widget._currentItemWidgets gives the widgets which are present in li or list item

title: Card Tap to Hide Widget
explanation: Handles tap gesture on card and hides a widget inside the tapped card. //widget._currentItemWidgets gives the widgets which are present in li or list item

title: Before Render Cards with Computed Values
syntax: [Scope].[WidgetName]Beforedatarender = function (widget, $data) { ... }; //$ data is the data assigned to that list either any varibale data or model data
explanation: Adds computed values like fullname, formatted budget, and flags low Q1 values before rendering cards.

title: Render List with Default Selection
syntax: [Scope].[WidgetName]Render = function(widget, $data) { }; //$ data is the data assigned to that list either any varibale data or model data
explanation: Selects the third list item on render and updates a card caption with selected name.

title: Reorder List  and Save Order
syntax: [Scope].[WidgetName]Reorder = function($event, data) { ... };//$ data is the data assigned to that list either any varibale data or model data
explanation: Handles list reordering and stores the updated item order into an App variable.

title: Get Widget by Index from List
synonyms: get widget in list by index
code: Page.Widgets.EmployeeList1.getWidgets('EmailID', 2).$element.addClass('text-bold');
explanation: Gets the 'EmailID' widget inside the 3rd item and applies a CSS class to it.

title: Get All Widgets by Name from List
synonyms: select widgets by name in list
code: const emailWidgets = Page.Widgets.EmployeeList1.getWidgets('EmailID');
explanation: Returns all widgets named 'EmailID' from the list items.

title: Get List Item Data by Index
code: let item = Page.Widgets.EmployeeList1.getItem(2).item;
explanation: Retrieves the data object for the item at index 2 from the list.

title: Access Selected List Item's Widget
code: Page.Widgets.EmployeeList1.selectedItemWidgets.EmailID.caption = 'Updated Caption';
explanation: Updates the caption of the 'EmailID' widget inside the currently selected list item.

title: Access Selected Item Data from List
code:
let selected = Page.Widgets.EmployeeList1.selecteditem;
console.log("Selected item:", selected);
explanation: Retrieves the currently selected item from the list and logs it.

title: Assign Value to Form Field Programmatically
code: Page.Widgets.employeeForm.formWidgets.employeeDob.datavalue = "AT_DEVOPS";
explanation: Sets a string value to the 'employeeDob' field in the 'employeeForm'.

title: Get Form Output Object
code: let formData = Page.Widgets.employeeForm.dataoutput;
explanation: Fetches the complete output object of 'employeeForm' into a variable.

title: Merge Two Form Outputs
code: Page.Widgets.employeeForm.dataoutput = { ...Page.Widgets.employeeForm.dataoutput, ...Page.Widgets.accessRequestForm.dataoutput };
explanation: Combines the data output from 'accessRequestForm' into the target form 'employeeForm'.
